title: 既有隧道漏水修繕~Leakage repair in existing tunnels
focus: 以水源診斷、活動裂縫與修補相容性處理既有隧道漏水~Repair existing-tunnel leakage through source diagnosis, active-crack assessment and material compatibility
summary: 本課以以水源診斷、活動裂縫與修補相容性處理既有隧道漏水為主線，從凝結與地下水來源與漏水量級與時間窗建立系統邊界，再把水頭正規化與成效、排水保留與壓力轉移連到修繕履歷與重複缺陷。可見出水口不一定是入水缺陷，修補不得破壞原有洩壓與排水路徑。 十單元以可核算的模型和可追溯證據逐步判讀不同失效。~This course focuses on repair existing-tunnel leakage through source diagnosis, active-crack assessment and material compatibility. It begins with Condensation and groundwater sources and Leakage scale and time windows, links Head normalization and repair effect and Drainage preservation and pressure transfer, and ends with Repair history and recurrent defects. The visible outlet need not be the entry defect; repair must preserve intended pressure relief and drainage. Ten units use reproducible models and traceable evidence to distinguish failure mechanisms.

units.anchor: 凝結與地下水來源~Condensation and groundwater sources
units.title: 凝結與地下水來源~Condensation and groundwater sources
units.mechanism: 潮濕表面可能來自冷凝、地層滲水或管線漏水，三者有不同控制方法。表面溫度低於露點支持凝結可能性，但不是唯一來源證明；空間分布、水質與時間變化應共同檢查，避免把整面冷凝誤當防水膜大面積破損。 判別這個機制時，應觀察同步量測表面溫度、露點、水質與濕區分布；若出現凝結被當成裂縫漏水灌補，濕氣問題仍然存在，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Wet surfaces can arise from condensation, groundwater or utilities, requiring different remedies. A surface below dew point supports condensation but does not exclude other sources. Combine spatial distribution, chemistry and timing rather than treating widespread condensation as widespread membrane failure. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Measure surface temperature, dew point, chemistry and wet-area distribution together. If condensation is treated as crack leakage and persists after sealing, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
units.model: 原創教學假設：temperatureMargin=surface-dewPoint=12 C-14 C=-2 C。可見出水口不一定是入水缺陷，修補不得破壞原有洩壓與排水路徑。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: temperatureMargin=surface-dewPoint=12 C-14 C=-2 C. The visible outlet need not be the entry defect; repair must preserve intended pressure relief and drainage. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.
units.verify: 同步量測表面溫度、露點、水質與濕區分布。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「凝結被當成裂縫漏水灌補，濕氣問題仍然存在」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。~Measure surface temperature, dew point, chemistry and wet-area distribution together. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Condensation is treated as crack leakage and persists after sealing. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to measure surface temperature, dew point, chemistry and wet-area distribution together to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.
units.misconception: 只要隧道表面有水就一定是地下水穿過裂縫~Any water on a tunnel surface must be groundwater passing through a crack
units.practice: 將同步量測表面溫度、露點、水質與濕區分布列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現凝結被當成裂縫漏水灌補，濕氣問題仍然存在，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。~Apply the following check at handover: Measure surface temperature, dew point, chemistry and wet-area distribution together. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If condensation is treated as crack leakage and persists after sealing, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

units.anchor: 漏水量級與時間窗~Leakage scale and time windows
units.title: 漏水量級與時間窗~Leakage scale and time windows
units.mechanism: 水滴頻率受滴頭形狀影響，不能不經校正就換成流量。集水時間窗需要涵蓋變化，維修前後也應使用相似水頭與環境；小流量持續多年仍可形成可觀水量和腐蝕暴露，因此應同時描述瞬時量與累積量。 判別這個機制時，應觀察以容積計時或流量計記錄同一漏點並保留水頭條件；若出現短時乾燥被當成修復成功，水頭回升後漏水恢復，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Drop frequency depends on outlet geometry and needs calibration before conversion to flow. Collection windows should capture variability and comparisons require similar head and environment. A small persistent leak can create substantial volume and corrosion exposure, so describe instantaneous and accumulated quantities. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Measure the same leak by timed volume or flow meter and retain head conditions. If a short dry interval is treated as repair success before leakage returns with rising head, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
units.model: 原創教學假設：dailyVolume=0.5 L/min*1440 min/day=720 L/day=0.72 m3/day。可見出水口不一定是入水缺陷，修補不得破壞原有洩壓與排水路徑。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: dailyVolume=0.5 L/min*1440 min/day=720 L/day=0.72 m3/day. The visible outlet need not be the entry defect; repair must preserve intended pressure relief and drainage. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If a short dry interval is treated as repair success before leakage returns with rising head, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

units.anchor: 裂縫活動與開合尺度~Crack activity and opening scale
units.title: 裂縫活動與開合尺度~Crack activity and opening scale
units.mechanism: 裂縫可能隨溫度、交通或地層變形反覆開合，靜態寬度不能代表活動範圍。修補材料需要適應裂縫位移而不只是填滿當下空隙；不同方向的剪移與張開也有不同界面需求，應在設計前取得可比時間序列。 判別這個機制時，應觀察以裂縫計對照溫度、荷載事件及相鄰結構位移；若出現活動裂縫採剛性填補後沿界面再裂，漏水很快回復，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Cracks can cycle with temperature, traffic or ground movement; static width does not describe their range. Repair needs movement compatibility rather than simply filling the current void. Shear and opening impose different interface demands, requiring comparable time histories before selecting a system. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare crack-gauge records with temperature, load events and neighbouring movement. If rigid filling of an active crack fractures again along the interface and leakage returns, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
units.model: 原創教學假設：openingRange=max-min=0.35 mm-0.20 mm=0.15 mm。可見出水口不一定是入水缺陷，修補不得破壞原有洩壓與排水路徑。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: openingRange=max-min=0.35 mm-0.20 mm=0.15 mm. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

units.anchor: 裂隙導流與非線性~Fracture conductance and nonlinearity
units.title: 裂隙導流與非線性~Fracture conductance and nonlinearity
units.mechanism: 理想裂隙流量對開度立方敏感，封閉一部分通道可能大幅改變流量，也可能讓水改走另一支路。天然裂縫的接觸及粗糙度限制此模型適用性，不能只靠出水量反推出唯一裂縫寬度；需用實測開合和水頭補足解釋。 判別這個機制時，應觀察在可比水頭下比較裂縫開口、流量及鄰近漏點變化；若出現單點流量下降只是水路改道，總湧水量沒有改善，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Ideal fracture flow varies cubically with aperture, so partial closure can strongly change discharge or redirect it. Contact and roughness limit the model, preventing unique width inference from outlet flow. Pair measured opening and head to interpret apparent hydraulic improvement. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare crack opening, flow and neighbouring leaks under comparable heads. If a local flow decrease merely redirects water and leaves total inflow unchanged, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

units.anchor: 水頭正規化與成效~Head normalization and repair effect
units.title: 水頭正規化與成效~Head normalization and repair effect
units.mechanism: 維修前後地下水頭不同時，流量變化混有外部驅動差異。線性導通度可在有限範圍比較同一路徑，但裂縫開合和多支路連通可能非線性；評估應保留原始水頭與流量，而不是只報一個百分比成效。 判別這個機制時，應觀察將修前後流量對水頭繪圖並比較可重疊範圍；若出現低水頭測得小流量被當成材料效果，高水頭時再度漏水，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Different groundwater heads mix external driving changes into before-after flow. Linear conductance can compare a path over a limited range, but opening and branching may be nonlinear. Preserve original head and flow rather than reporting only a percentage improvement. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Plot before-after flow against head and compare overlapping ranges. If low-head low flow is credited to material performance and leakage returns at higher head, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

units.anchor: 修補材料與濕界面~Repair materials and wet interfaces
units.title: 修補材料與濕界面~Repair materials and wet interfaces
units.mechanism: 材料能否在潮濕界面形成有效密封取決於化學相容、黏結及變形能力，不由單一強度決定。水流可能帶走未穩定材料，基底污染則形成薄弱層；試驗應重現服務環境和裂縫活動，而不是只測乾燥室內黏著。 判別這個機制時，應觀察比較濕態黏結、變形循環及水質相容試驗證據；若出現乾態合格材料在濕界面剝離，留下隱藏通水薄層，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Sealing a wet interface depends on chemistry, bond and movement capacity rather than one strength. Flow can remove unstable material and contamination creates a weak layer. Tests should represent service moisture and movement instead of only dry laboratory adhesion. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare wet bond, movement cycling and water-chemistry compatibility evidence. If a material passing dry tests debonds wet and leaves a hidden water-conducting layer, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

units.anchor: 修繕履歷與重複缺陷~Repair history and recurrent defects

example: 整合算例所有輸入均為教學假設。首先檢查凝結與地下水來源：temperatureMargin=surface-dewPoint=12 C-14 C=-2 C；再獨立檢查漏水量級與時間窗：dailyVolume=0.5 L/min*1440 min/day=720 L/day=0.72 m3/day。露點保持 14°C，表面溫度由 12 升為 15°C，溫度餘裕由 -2 變為 +1°C；這只改變凝結可能性，不能排除同時存在的裂縫滲漏。 兩個結果不能自動組成完整設計，因為可見出水口不一定是入水缺陷，修補不得破壞原有洩壓與排水路徑。 將以代表性水樣、接觸時間及鋼材厚度量測追蹤暴露作為模型以外的驗證證據，並保留原始紀錄與尚待確認的邊界。~All inputs in this integrated example are teaching assumptions. First check Condensation and groundwater sources: temperatureMargin=surface-dewPoint=12 C-14 C=-2 C. Independently check Leakage scale and time windows: dailyVolume=0.5 L/min*1440 min/day=720 L/day=0.72 m3/day. At a fixed 14 C dew point, surface temperature rising from 12 to 15 C changes the margin from -2 to +1 C; this changes condensation potential but does not exclude simultaneous crack leakage. The two results are not a complete design because the visible outlet need not be the entry defect; repair must preserve intended pressure relief and drainage. Use track exposure using representative water samples, contact duration and steel thickness as evidence independent of the calculation, retaining raw records and unverified boundaries.
history: 本課討論的以水源診斷、活動裂縫與修補相容性處理既有隧道漏水，反映地下工程由單一構件強度走向地層、施工時序與維護共同驗證的發展。可見出水口不一定是入水缺陷，修補不得破壞原有洩壓與排水路徑。 1992 年 CEDD 岩洞指南初版、2009 年 FHWA 隧道土木手冊及 2018 年岩洞指南第二版提供公開閱讀脈絡。哥達與英法海底隧道僅作地質及地下水邊界的比較，本課不主張取得其專有圖說或現場數據，只重建公開原理。~The focus on repair existing-tunnel leakage through source diagnosis, active-crack assessment and material compatibility reflects the development from isolated member strength toward combined ground, sequence and maintenance verification. The visible outlet need not be the entry defect; repair must preserve intended pressure relief and drainage. The 1992 first CEDD cavern guide, 2009 FHWA civil tunnel manual and 2018 second cavern-guide edition provide public context. Gotthard and the Channel Tunnel are comparisons of geological and groundwater boundaries only. This course claims no proprietary drawings or field data and reconstructs public principles.
